source.title: Solution of an open problem posed by Gale

trace.notes: Input URL was a zbMATH resolver record. Direct fetch of https://zbmath.org/1156674 was blocked by a Cloudflare challenge in local curl. The zbMATH REST API, after accepting its terms page, identified the record as zbMATH ID 1156674: S. Ikeler, T. L. Morin, and N. Prabhu, title Solution of an open problem posed by Gale, Congressus Numerantium 111, 49-64 (1995). The API record exposed metadata and a summary but no readable full-text links.

Bounded exact-work recovery tried the zbMATH ID, the exact title plus PDF, the exact title plus authors, and the exact title plus venue/pages. Search results did not recover a readable exact-work PDF or HTML source. The visible candidate Gale Round-Trip Jeep Problem was rejected because it has a different title, authors, and venue (American Mathematical Monthly 102(4), 1995) from the zbMATH record.

No open questions were extracted because the only confirmed exact-work source was resolver metadata. The workflow forbids extracting technical problem statements from metadata, abstracts, search snippets, or related papers.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/1156674.json and outputs/latest.json.
